acceptance_checks: P1.2.1 is satisfied by replacing brittle workflow substring checks with structured workflow extraction.
P1.2.2 is satisfied by adding a bounded internal JSON Schema validator with explicit unsupported-feature failures.
P1.2.3 is satisfied by structurally validating workflow permissions, job names, triggers, and required checks.
P1.2.4 is satisfied by adding CI actionlint and shellcheck coverage with deterministic local skip behavior.
P1.2.5 is satisfied by adding false-positive and false-negative validator hardening tests.
Node.js 20 deprecation handling is bounded to official action upgrades, Node 24 compatibility mode, unsafe opt-out rejection, and docs.
Verification bundle passes: validate_shiki, py_compile, scripts/test_shiki_*.sh, and git diff --check.
non_goals: Do not implement P1.3 architecture split.
Do not implement P1.4 governance or evidence model redesign.
Do not implement P2 repository presentation, release, or packaging work.
Do not redesign runtime adapters or add external storage.
Do not change Guardian approval semantics or CCA Review Bridge semantics.
Do not change branch protection policy or CODEOWNERS ownership rules.
Do not change P0.4 ID, lock, or evidence semantics.
scope: Close Goal #30 P1.2.1-P1.2.5 by hardening Shiki validator and workflow checks with structured workflow parsing, bounded JSON Schema validation, required-check drift detection, CI actionlint/shellcheck coverage, Node 24 compatibility handling, and false-positive/false-negative regression tests.
title: Harden validator and workflow checks
